identity.name: White Horde
alt_names: Left wing of the Jochid ulus

land.text: the eastern half of the Golden Horde's 1352 shape: the Kazakh steppe, the Syr Darya, Khwarazm and the Siberian margin

predecessors.note: Cliopatria's Golden Horde row ends in 1362; Orda's ulus is older (page: 'formed around 1225').

land.text: Orda's ulus, reunited with the Blue Horde's lands by Tokhtamysh

successors.note: The golden-horde dossier draws the union as golden-horde_1381 (1381-1384).

capitals.name: Sighnaq (Sygnaq), on the Syr Darya
capitals.note: Page: 'originally at Lake Balkhash, later moved to Sygnaq, Kazakhstan on the Syr-Darya River' (undated); the Tokhtamysh page has Tokhtamysh installed at Sighnaq in 1379. Coordinates are approximate and Sighnaq is not in the gazetteer (use the Syr Darya near Turkistan).

keyframe_review.note: 2.52 M km2 for 1363-1374 (8,473 cells): the Kazakh steppe, the Syr Darya, most of Khwarazm and the Siberian margin to 85.7 E. The page has no infobox or area. It says the ulus 'included western Central Asia and south-western Siberia', with its first seat 'at Lake Balkhash' and a later seat 'at Sygnaq, Kazakhstan on the Syr-Darya River' (both undated), which matches the shape. One doubt: the shape contains 647 of the 844 cells of the gazetteer's Khwarezm, and the Tokhtamysh page has him 'restore Golden Horde authority over the Sufi Dynasty in Khwarazm' only in 1383, which implies the Horde's hold had lapsed before; kept as Cliopatria draws it (unverified: page budget). fx-29 (F128): the Sufi dynasty dossier founds a state of its own on Khwarezm in c.1361 (Sufi page: Husain Sufi 'took control of Urgench and the rest of the northern part of Khwarezm', infobox 'Founded c. 1361', 'independence was short-lived' to 1379, though it also says the dynasty 'ruled in Khwarezm within the realm of the Golden Horde'), and the White Horde page never mentions Khwarazm; the 647 Khwarezm cells are cut from this shape so they stay with the Sufi dynasty.

correction.text: the White Horde shape without Khwarezm, which the Sufi dynasty holds from c.1361 (Husain Sufi 'took control of Urgench and the rest of the northern part of Khwarezm'; coins minted for him from 1364)

keyframe_review.note: Same shape as 1363 (2.52 M km2) for 1375-1384 in Cliopatria, but the White Horde ends in 1380. The page: 'when his nephew Toqtamish wrested control of the White Horde ... in 1378'; the Tokhtamysh page: he took Sighnaq in 1379 and in 1380 'Qaghan Beg and Arab Shah submitted to him', 'the first khan in over two decades to rule both halves (wings) of the Golden Horde'. From 1381 the golden-horde dossier draws the union as its keyframe golden-horde_1381 (1381-1384) and its 1385 shape. Years cut to 1375-1380, shape unchanged. fx-29 (F128): Khwarezm cut as in the 1363 keyframe (640 cells shared with the Sufi dynasty in 1375; Sufi page: independence c.1361-1379). [orchestrator 2 Nov 2026: from/to set to 1375..1380 from this entry's own 'valid for 1375-1380 only'; without them the compiler drew the shape for all its Cliopatria years, overlapping the next keyframe (window p1100-p1199 report)]

correction.text: the 1375 shape without Khwarezm (the Sufi dynasty's land), valid for 1375-1380 only; from 1381 the land is the Golden Horde's

ledger.note: 1363: Orda's ulus is drawn as a state of its own. Page: 'formed around 1225, after the death of Jochi', Orda inheriting the left-wing appanage; no page dates its separation from Sarai (the Blue Horde page has the Blue Horde's 'period of anarchy (1359-1380)'). 1363 is Cliopatria's first year, after the Golden Horde row ends in 1362. fx-29 review (F128): Khwarezm cut from the found region as from keyframes 1363 and 1375; Sufi dynasty page: infobox 'Founded c. 1361', 'Husain Sufi took control of Urgench and the rest of the northern part of Khwarezm', independence 'c. 1361 - 1379'.

region.text: Orda's ulus, the left wing of the Jochid ulus: western Central Asia and south-western Siberia, seat at Sighnaq; without Khwarezm, the Sufi dynasty's from c.1361

ledger.note: 1373: Urus Khan of the eastern horde takes Sarai from Mamai's khan. 'In 1373, Sarai attracted a new conqueror, Urus Khan', who 'appears to have ejected Mamai's protege Muhammad-Sultan from Sarai' and expelled him again in 1374 (Mamai page). The White Horde page dates Urus's claim to both hordes to 1375 ('In 1375, Urus Khan ... became a contested khan of both the Blue Horde and the White Horde'). Zone is the reading: the Sarai seat that the two hordes fought over. Year moved from 1375 by reviewer ia-02-b to match the blue-horde dossier's contest_start.

region.text: Sarai and the Lower Volga, the seat that changed hands between Mamai's and Urus's khans

ledger.note: 1380: Tokhtamysh settles it. 'Qaghan Beg and Arab Shah submitted to him' (1380) after he took Sighnaq in 1379 and Urus's line had ended ('Urus died in 1377', White Horde page).

region.text: Sarai and the Lower Volga, the seat that changed hands between Mamai's and Urus's khans

ledger.note: 1380: the wings are reunited. Tokhtamysh was 'the first khan in over two decades to rule both halves (wings) of the Golden Horde'; he wrested the White Horde in 1378 and took Sarai in early 1380; the Golden Horde infobox gives 1379 and the Blue Horde page 1380.

region.text: Orda's ulus, joined to the Blue Horde's lands under Tokhtamysh

ledger.note: 1380: the White Horde as a separate state ends. The White Horde page keeps an Orda ulus alive to 1446 ('Kuruichik was appointed head of the White Horde by Tamerlane' after 1395-1396; Baraq 1421; 'In 1446 ... ending the existence of Orda's ulus'), but as a province of the Golden Horde and then of the Timurid sphere, with no Cliopatria shape; the last year drawn here is 1380.

region.text: Orda's ulus, passing to the Golden Horde

wars.name: Great Troubles (White Horde side)
wars.outcome: The eastern ulus under Urus Khan (to 1377) and then Tokhtamysh (1378) contests the Sarai seat with Mamai's western horde and wins it in early 1380.
wars.note: The White Horde page dates the anarchy 1359-1380 and Chimtay's brothers' murders to it. Reviewer ia-02-b clipped the war to this dossier's life (1363-1380): from 1359 to 1363; the pages' fuller span is in the outcome.

wars.name: Tokhtamysh's seizure of the White Horde
wars.outcome: Tokhtamysh, backed by Timur, installs himself at Otrar and Sayram in 1376, is declared khan after Urus's death in 1377, wrests the White Horde in 1378 and is installed at Sighnaq in 1379 after Timur Malik's execution at Qara-Tal; no land changes hands between states.
wars.note: The White Horde page has the 1378 date; the Tokhtamysh page has the rest.

certainty.note: Steppe and desert frontiers drawn approximate; the southern edge on the Syr Darya and in Khwarazm is the least certain.

notes: Two pages only (budget 1-2). The White Horde page has no infobox, area or rulers list and gives no month. Cliopatria's row is 1363-1384; this dossier ends it in 1380 (Tokhtamysh, see the keyframe), so Cliopatria's 1381-1384 years are drawn by the golden-horde dossier. After 1380 the page keeps an Orda ulus to 1446: Kuruichik appointed head of the White Horde by Tamerlane after Tokhtamysh's defeat in 1395-1396, his descendant Baraq asserting the Golden Horde throne in 1421, the ulus splitting under Mohammed and Mustafa, 'in 1446 ... Abu'l-Khayr ... ending the existence of Orda's ulus', and the families merging into the Uzbek and Kazakh hordes (undated). Cliopatria has no shape for this (the Kazakh steppe is nobody's in 1402-1428 and Sibir's from 1429), so it is NOT drawn here; a dossier for the Ulus of Orda 1396-1446 and the Uzbek and Kazakh hordes is needed (ia-02-x). The Khwarazm question (kept in the shape, doubtful) is in the 1363 verdict. Disagreement: the Mamai page dates Urus's seizure of Sarai to 1373, the White Horde page his claim to both hordes to 1375. Gazetteer name: Sighnaq (place, Syr Darya, Kazakhstan). Page budget: two of two.
